reviews.reason: web/app/src/features/frontstage/pages/frontstage-page/controllers/use-frontstage-page-refresh.ts:64（react-doctor/async-defer-await）：await 之后的 early return 是 stream/run/page generation 的并发失效检查：必须在异步网络/stream/hydration 完成后再次检查，才能防止旧响应覆盖新会话。把 return 提前并删除完成后的检查无法检测等待期间发生的切换；这些 await 的结果或完成顺序被后续映射/refresh 使用。 P17b reassessed 2026-11-17: FrontStagePage adds registered data-block creation, provider and overlay wiring. It still delegates refresh to this unchanged controller; post-await generation checks fence old responses, and page/tab changes invalidate generation and reset pending/error state.
